definition: to not notice something right in front of you
description: In a sunny city park, a big red, yellow and blue hot air balloon crash-lands behind a wooden bench, its wicker basket tearing up the grass while the pilot clings on, and people run and a dog dashes away. On the bench a young woman with long black hair, headphones and sunglasses on her head, in a white shirt and beige trousers, calmly reads a book and sips an iced drink through a straw, a paper bag of pastries beside her. She never looks up while the basket tips over and families picnic further back.

en.question: What is the seated woman doing?

de.question: Was macht die sitzende Frau gerade?

es.answer: Está ignorando el globo que se estrella.
